sources.title: FlyBrain -- Kainos Workday AI CoE
sources.snippet: A fruit fly brain fits on a pinhead but contains circuits for memory, navigation, fear, hunger, and decision-making. If we can simulate this brain in a web browser today, imagine what becomes possible as we map larger brains.
